newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Golf-Kelly hits round of day to be one off lead.
newsitem.headline: Golf-Kelly hits round of day to be one off lead.

text.p: U.S. golfer Jerry Kelly fired a six-under-par second round of 66 on Friday to be one stroke of lead at the halfway point of the Australian PGA championship at the New South Wales Golf Club.
Kelly's was the best round of the day and put him just behind a three-way tie for the lead between Australian golfers Justin Cooper, Peter Lonard and Chris Gray.
Cooper holed a birdie putt at the par four 18th hole to join Lonard and Gray on six-under 138. Cooper's final hole birdie gave him a round of 68, while Lonard shot a 69 and Gray a 70.
Lonard was out early on Friday to join 53 other players in completing their first rounds after strong winds disrupted play on Thursday.
Lonard birdied four of the first five holes on his second round to briefly hold the outright lead.
